desc:
UPDATE!!
- Minus One Gojira is here!
- Crossroads map
- UI style change
- Bug fixes

Welcome to YVSK (You VS Kaiju)!
up to 9 survivors are tasked with surviving the kaiju that comes from the bay...
As a survivor your goal is to stay alive until the time runs out.
But if you happen to become the kaiju...
your task is to destroy their cover and kill them all.
game is in beta... but enjoy!
and join the social link please

Active codes:
1KLIKES - 1000 cells
10KMEMBERS - 1000 cells, 2 hours of x2 cells
BETATEST - survivor skin
MINUSONE - 500 cells

Some icons and thumbnails by Overdrive X
Some models by boundedbyfear 
Heisei and Burning models from the creators of Kaiju Legacy
Inspired by You VS homer and BEAR (alpha) 1 vs all style gameplay
because we need another asym game on the platform
